# MERA Auto-Generated Code (Fall Detection)

This directory contains C source code auto-generated by RUHMI (MERA) Framework
for the fall detection model (YOLOv8 pico INT8) targeting Ethos-U55 NPU.

## How to generate

```bash
bash scripts/deploy_fall_detection.sh
```

See `doc/analysis_report/f003_04_mera_conversion_guide.md` for details.

## Source model

- `dataset/models/yolov8_pico_fall_int8.tflite` (366KB, 192x192x3, INT8)
